name: Upson
schedule: First Tuesday when scheduled, Thomaston-Upson Civic Center
note: Lists appear only as Upson Beacon legal notices. No results or excess funds are posted.

auction.time: First Tuesday of the sale month, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm, continuing the next day if necessary
auction.registration: Bidders should register before the sale at the tag and tax office in the downtown courthouse annex, per the Tax Commissioner's sale announcement in the county legal organ.
auction.payment: Cash or certified funds. No payment deadline is published.
auction.office_address: 305 S Hightower St, Ste. D-120, Thomaston, GA 30286 (mailing: P.O. Box 409, Thomaston, GA 30286)
vital: The purchaser pays for title, all transfer costs, all taxes, advertising costs and recording fees.
The Tax Commissioner urges bidders to view a property before bidding and says all sales are final.
The county website has no tax sale page. Sales are announced through the legal ads in the Upson Beacon, so confirm the date and room with the office.
Georgia law: tax sales are buyer beware (O.C.G.A. 9-13-167) and the tax deed carries no warranty of title.

Georgia law: the owner or any lienholder may redeem for 12 months after the sale, and until the right to redeem is foreclosed, by paying the bid plus a 20% premium, plus 10% for each additional year (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45).
